set: LEGO Technic 42175 Volvo EC230 Electric Excavator (excavator booklet, bags 12-17)

input.model_so_far: Turntable with pump deck, two side frames and a cross beam (steps 18-21).

new_parts.position: grey air T-piece that joins two hoses

new_parts.position: two grey pneumatic switch blocks, one on each end of the hose line

new_parts.position: two blue 6-long air hoses (length checked 1:1 on page 24)

what_each_new_part_touches: Sub-step 1: the two blue hoses are pushed onto the two ends of the grey T-piece. Sub-step 2: the free hose ends go onto a nozzle of each grey switch block, one block at each end of the line.
Page 25: the finished air line is laid across the model; each switch block sits on pins sticking out of the two side frames (arrow).
where_everything_is_after: a blue air line runs from one side frame to the other with a switch block at each end; the T-piece's third nozzle is still free for the pump hose

why.problem_solved: Starts the air plumbing: this line will carry air from the pump to the two air cylinders.
why.why_these_parts: A T-piece splits the pump's air into two branches; a switch block on each branch lets the driver choose which cylinder moves.
why.sets_up_for_later: Steps 24 and later fit the cylinders and the pump hose.

review_note: Switch blocks have no connection data in the catalog, so their joins to the frame pins are marked ? (not shown). Hoses are matched by the 1:1 length check (6L, 4.8 cm).
